title: Make in India
summary: Make in India — Government Scheme study notes covering operational framework and key exam parameters.

blocks.title: 📋 Scheme Study Overview
blocks.text: Verified standalone scheme summary. Key administrative parameters and operational guidelines.

items: (Launched on September 25, 2014) aims to transform India into a global manufacturing hub, driving
Focus Areas: Initially 25 sectors, expanded to 27 under Make in India 2.0.
Increase manufacturing’s share in GDP from 16% to 25% by 2022.
Create 10 crore jobs in manufacturing by 2022.
Establish Indian manufacturing as a global brand.
FDI Growth: Increased foreign investment in key sectors.
Ease of Doing Business: Reforms in labor laws and infrastructure.
Focus Sectors: Automobiles, defense, textiles, IT, electronics, and renewable energy.
